attempted_at_note: attempted_at and every http_status are REPORTED by the verification subagent that performed the fetch. No script under scripts/ makes a network call, so no deterministic component can record or re-check them. What IS script-computed: the host allowlist, each entry status, and the verified/unverified counts.

research.title: Quantifying Language Models' Sensitivity to Spurious Features in Prompt Design or: How I learned to start worrying about prompt formatting
research.rationale: Reports that formatting-only prompt changes swing task accuracy by a wide margin, which bounds how much any persona-text edit can be credited.

research.title: State of What Art? A Call for Multi-Prompt LLM Evaluation
research.rationale: Argues single-prompt evaluation is unreliable and can reorder model rankings; relevant to any claim measured on one prompt.

research.title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
research.rationale: Builds a failure taxonomy for multi-agent LLM systems from annotated traces — the closest published work to this repo's council and lens design.
